title: GPPM_PAAG_CSM: code and results of the pre-specified 20-seed PAAG/CSM ablation for pneumonia detection on geriatric chest radiographs
description: Code, frozen configuration, run records of all 109 runs, results of the 80 confirmatory models, localisation, external PadChest evaluation, Protocol 1 summary results and the analysis that produces every number in the article Attention gating and comorbidity suppression do not improve pneumonia detection on geriatric chest radiographs: a pre-specified 20-seed ablation of DenseNet-121 with an analysis of training length (submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). Model weights and label-free predictions: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23590668. No images or labels are included.
